summary: SrTiO3 thin films were deposited using plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) with Sr(tmhd)2 and Ti(i-OPr)4 as precursors. The process was conducted at temperatures between 250–350 °C, and the films showed good step coverage and low carbon contamination. The study aimed to address the challenges of depositing high dielectric materials like SrTiO3 for capacitor applications.
